title: WC Calculator
description: Offline Electron desktop app for electrical wire and conduit sizing. Enter material, insulation, and circuit breaker rating to get the minimum conductor size, with multi-set support, AWG/conduit reference tables, and light/dark themes.

title: Timey
description: A lightweight, persistent desktop app for focus sessions and productivity tracking, built with Electron, React, and TypeScript with Supabase-backed sync.

title: JOYn
description: A multi-user platform for organizing and joining group activities, with role-based access for joiners, organizers, and moderators, plus real-time chat, notifications, image uploads, and map integration. Capstone project.

title: TREX Voice
description: Browser-based ephemeral voice chat on LiveKit WebRTC. No accounts or installs: join password-protected rooms with push-to-talk or open mic, and rooms auto-expire when empty, keeping it fast on low-spec devices.

title: NASA APOD
description: Delivers daily astronomical content, using PostgreSQL caching for instant, rate-limit-free API discovery.
